column1: # Lama Temple and Hama: Xian to Altin continuity, Hsu rescue, Jupiter Reveal, desert warnings. Event endings preserved.

column3: Mind the loose rock!{page_break}One wrong blow\ncould bring down\nthe ceiling.{end_wait}

Those who see
what eyes conceal
may find the truth.{page_break}So the inscription
reads.{end_wait}
Welcome to Lama Temple.{page_break}The desert ahead\nis merciless.\nRest before crossing.{end_wait}
Have you traveled\nfrom the east?{end_now}
Then you've crossed\nLamakan Desert.{page_break}You must be\nexhausted.{end_wait}
Did you visit Xian\non your journey?{end_now}
Master Feh of Xian\nknows Master Hama.{page_break}Their students\noften train here.{end_wait}
Then you've come\nto a good place.{page_break}Our masters teach\npatience and focus.{end_wait}
Do you know\nwhat meditation is?{end_now}
Close your eyes\nand quiet your breath.{page_break}Learn to listen\nwithout fear.{end_wait}
Clear your thoughts.\nBe still as stone.{page_break}That is where\ntraining begins.{end_wait}

Your thoughts race
with worry.{page_break}Rest a moment.
No one is chasing
you here.{end_wait}
Have you heard\nof Master Hama?{end_now}
Then you know\nof Master Feh.{page_break}Hama's knowledge\ngoes beyond Chi.{end_wait}
Stay and observe.\nYou may learn\nsomething valuable.{end_wait}
They look frightened.{page_break}The desert will\nshow them no mercy.{end_wait}
Training can prepare\nthe body for pain.{page_break}It cannot make\nus invincible.{end_wait}
That monk is hungry.\nHe hasn't eaten\nsince yesterday.{end_wait}
Master Hama studies\nmore than Chi.{page_break}Her wisdom reaches\nfar beyond this temple.{end_wait}
Master Hama is\nmeditating.{page_break}Please speak softly.{end_wait}
How could she know\nwe'd arrive today?{end_wait}
I expected you\nto come.{end_wait}
You were waiting\nfor us?{end_wait}
For a long time.{page_break}You seek\nthe Elemental Stars.{end_wait}
You know about\nthe Stars?{page_break}Who are you?{end_wait}
I'm not a Jupiter\nAdept! What are\nyou saying?{end_wait}
You can read\nthe thoughts\nof others, yes?{end_wait}
That gift belongs\nto Jupiter Adepts.{end_wait}
You knew we'd come.{page_break}Was that Psynergy?{end_wait}
Yes. Some Jupiter\nAdepts can sense\nwhat lies ahead.{end_wait}
You already possess\nthe gift.{page_break}You simply haven't\nlearned to use it.{end_wait}
Jupiter's power\ncan glimpse\nthe future?{end_wait}
I have waited\nto teach you Reveal.{end_wait}
You will need Reveal\nto complete\nyour journey.{end_wait}
Jupiter Adepts may\nlearn it in time.{page_break}But time is\nwhat you lack.{end_wait}
Saturos is still moving.{page_break}Each delay puts\nmore lives at risk.{end_wait}
Saturos and his party\ntook the western road.{end_wait}
A terrible fate?\nWhat do you mean?{end_wait}
I cannot speak\nof that burden.{page_break}Please do not\nask me again.{end_wait}
We must speak\nof Reveal now.{end_wait}
Reveal will help\nyou cross Lamakan.{end_wait}
What makes the\ndesert so dangerous?{end_now}
Why do we need\nReveal out there?{end_wait}
The desert was\nalready deadly\nin ordinary heat.{end_wait}
Now something has\nmade the heat\neven worse.{end_wait}
Anyone who enters\nwithout preparation\nmay die there.{end_wait}
Then how did Saturos\nmake it across?{end_wait}
Saturos and Menardi\nare Mars Adepts.{end_wait}
Their powers may\nshield them\nfrom the heat.{end_wait}
How can Reveal\nhelp us survive?{end_wait}
Reveal can expose\nwater hidden\nby a mirage.{end_wait}
Can't we just\nlook for water?{end_wait}
Do you know\nwhat a mirage is?{end_now}

The desert is full
of false images.{page_break}Without Reveal,
you may pass
real water by.{end_wait}
Heat bends the air\nand hides the land.{page_break}Your eyes alone\nwill mislead you.{end_wait}
I don't intend\nto die out there!{end_wait}
I cannot promise\nthat it will work.{end_wait}
I once tried\nto pass a gift\nto a young girl.{page_break}It was not Reveal.{end_wait}
She was not\nan Adept.{end_wait}
I believed anyone\nwith a gift\ncould strengthen it.{end_wait}
But I saw\nno change in her.{end_wait}
Feizhi?\nWhy are you here?{end_wait}
What did you sense?{end_wait}
Hsu left the temple\nsome time ago.{end_wait}
I know.\nHe never returned\nto Xian.{end_wait}
The fallen rocks\nin the mountains...{end_wait}
I sensed danger.{page_break}I came through\nthe mine to ask\nfor help.{end_wait}
Why has this gift\nawakened only now?{end_wait}
A stone fell\nfrom the sky\nand struck me.{end_wait}
Then perhaps\nmy teaching\ndid reach you.{end_wait}
We must help Hsu.\nThere's no time\nto lose.{end_wait}
Master Hama, wait!\nWhat about Reveal?{end_wait}
Feizhi's gift\nhas awakened.{page_break}I believe you\ncan learn as well.{end_wait}
Use Reveal\nto cross the desert.{end_wait}
You have learned Reveal.{page_break}Trust it when\nthe desert deceives you.{end_wait}
No... Yet somehow\nshe feels familiar.{end_wait}
Then we should\nleave at once!{end_wait}
The desert may\nhave slowed them.{page_break}We must not\nlose more time.{end_wait}
We can't just\nleave them behind!{end_wait}
Master Hama may\nneed our help.{end_wait}
